text:
marie: Quick check — final QA for the product story is queued. I want to lock CTAs + lead routing before I hand off to web. Can folks confirm the demo/webinar mapping and UTM rules? (I need this live by Tue 9am PT)

devon: Got it. timeline ok for Tue AM. Do we have variant CTAs for enterprise vs self-serve?

marie: Yes — two CTAs. enterprise -> 'Request a demo' (leads -> SFDC: AE queue); self-serve -> 'Try Redwood API' (leads -> marketing nurture). I'll paste mapping.

marie: ```
ctas:
  - id: enterprise_demo
    label: "Request a demo"
    route: sfdc_queue=ae_enterprise
    utm_campaign: gtm_product_story_enterprise
  - id: try_api
    label: "Try Redwood API"
    route: marketing_nurture_list
    utm_campaign: gtm_product_story_selfserve
``` 

logan: Design check — hero CTA should be 'Try Redwood API' on mobile. I'll add a second tap target for 'Request a demo' in footer.

sanjeev: For inbound rules, I'll set lead scoring: demo leads + company_size>100 -> sales_alert. Also add source=blog + utm_medium=organic. Can we standardize utm_content to `headline_variant`?

ellie: Legal quick pass: confirm no comparative claims and the benchmark phrasing has source link. Marie — send the benchmark CSV to me and I'll sign off today.

marie: Uploaded CSV to the thread and to Google Drive: https://drive.redwood/example-benchmarks (comment for access). Also pairing with Legal on phrasing now.

publish-bot: Scheduled publish preview set for 2024-03-25T16:00:00Z. Please run final smoke test 30m before.

marie: Final ask — can someone run the smoke test at 15:30 PT on publish day and confirm lead routing by posting a test lead with utm_campaign=gtm_product_story_selfserve? I'll handle the copy tweaks. :raised_hands:

devon: I can run smoke tests. I'll post test lead and screenshot once done. :+1:

sanjeev: I'll verify SFDC mapping too. tagging @ellie if any legal flags pop up.

ellie: Will review CSV now. If anything, I'll ping within the hour.

marie: Thanks team — once smoke test passes i'll flip the last toggle. :rocket:
